bio: Hi! I am Andrew Le Blanc from South Padre Island, Texas. I live in Straus Hall and plan to study Economics and Computer Science. Outside of FYSC, you will probably find me either at Hemenway or locked in at Cabot. I am super excited to be a part of FYSC to plan events for our class, and to bring us together! If you have any recommendations or questions, feel free to reach out to me!
